svg.title: Umbra against Playwright, time per action
svg.desc: Median milliseconds per action on the same local pages, 20 runs each, log scale. Accessibility snapshot: Umbra 0.9, Chromium 3.6, WebKit 4.4; Click + DOM update: Umbra 1.5, Chromium 16, WebKit 66; Fill a React-controlled field: Umbra 1.3, Chromium 2.1, WebKit 3; Eval round trip: Umbra 0.2, Chromium 0.3, WebKit 0.4; Viewport screenshot to a file: Umbra 50, Chromium 85, WebKit 57; Warm navigate (local page): Umbra 13, Chromium 6.5, WebKit 13. Playwright 1.62.1 with Chromium 151.0.7922.34 and WebKit 26.5, in one warm Node process; Umbra daemon socket; MCP framing is not timed.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Read and act in about a millisecond
